sentences.en: The more you suffer in life, the more compassionate you become.
sentences.zh: 你经历的生活越多苦难，你就变得越有同情心。

sentences.en: My parents taught me to be a compassionate person.
sentences.zh: 我的父母教会我做一个有同情心的人。

sentences.en: I was really broken at the time and she was very compassionate.
sentences.zh: 我当时真的非常沮丧，但她却表现得非常有同情心。

senses.zh: 表示怜悯的,有同情心的
